name: Oil Rig Drill Swivel
description: The swivel connects to the end of a drill rod, and has fluid ports for drilling slurry and crude oil. Pumping a supply of drilling slurry through a drill rod is required for effective drilling.
shortDescription: A swivel for transferring fluids through a drill rod.

logicNodes.label: Clamp Rod
logicNodes.description: Attach a drill rod to the swivel.

logicNodes.label: Rod Clamped
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a drill rod is attached.

logicNodes.label: Fluid In
logicNodes.description: Fluid port to transfer drilling slurry through an attached rod linked to a well.

logicNodes.label: Fluid Out
logicNodes.description: Fluid port to transfer drilling slurry from an attached rod linked to a well.
